definition: The DTI — a real-time classification system that rates every known synthetic life form on a scale from 0 (inert fragment) to 10 (Leviathan-class existential threat). Updated continuously by Axiom Security's synthetic intelligence division. E.L.F.s rate 0.1-1.5. Strays rate 1-3. Prowlers rate 3-6. Leviathans rate 7-10. DEEP CURRENT, the oldest known Leviathan, carries a permanent DTI of 9.8.
origin: Axiom Security classification — the system by which corponations prioritize synthetic threats
example: DTI just spiked to 4.2 in the Circuit. Something woke up down there.
